title: weftc IR v1 — StructLayout intermediate representation
description: Schema-document IR consumed by the weftc managed codegen backends (ts/swift/dart/python). Engineer 1's IrSchema/StructLayout AST maps onto this via a thin adapter; until that lands, canonical fixtures live beside this file. All layouts are strictly little-endian (Law 2) and naturally aligned.

generator.description: Provenance string of the producer, e.g. weftc-core/0.3.0 or weftc-managed/1.0.0.

name.description: camelCase logical field name; backends transliterate to their own conventions.

offset.description: Byte offset of the first element from the start of the struct window.

count.description: Fixed array element count. count > 1 renders an inline fixed-size array.

const.description: Expected value. Integral/float types: number or hexU64 string (u64). u8 arrays: string of ASCII bytes (e.g. "WEFT"). When present, validateHeader() asserts it (Law 4).

role.description: Semantic hint. reserved fields are excluded from fluent setters; magic/schemaId/schemaVersion participate in validateHeader().

namespace.description: Optional dotted namespace used by language module systems.

endian.description: Law 2: strict little-endian. Big-endian layouts are rejected at load time.
